employees.basis: total number of Toyota employees, on a consolidated basis

source.label: FY2026 Form 20-F, Item 6.D Employees
source.quote: The total number of Toyota employees, on a consolidated basis, was 390,927 as of March 31, 2026, 383,853 as of March 31, 2025, and 380,793 as of March 31, 2024.

source.label: FY2026 Form 20-F, note 23 Employee benefits, (9) Payroll expenses
source.quote: Payroll expenses included in “Cost of products sold” and “Selling, general and administrative” in the consolidated statement of income (including expenses for post-employment benefit plans) for the years ended March 31, 2024, 2025 and 2026 are ¥4,385,112 million, ¥4,794,497 million and ¥5,081,959 million, respectively.

notes: Employees: year-end head count at March 31, 2026, consolidated. It excludes temporary employees, whose average number during fiscal 2026 was 99,032 (20-F Item 6.D). Payroll: note 23(9) 'Payroll expenses' of ¥5,081,959 million, as reported: the payroll included in cost of products sold and SG&A, including post-employment benefit plan costs. Payroll in the cost of financial services, if any, is not stated separately. Billions of JPY.
